recentItems.title: TEAM OF THE YEAR AND YOUNG WOMEN'S PLAYER OF THE YEAR 🏆 | Arsenal at the 2026 PFA Awards BTS
recentItems.description:
It was a busy night in Manchester as we scooped up a host of honours at the PFA Awards, and you can see what went down with our behind the scenes special.

Nine of our stars were on the red carpet at the Manchester Opera House as Olivia Smith won the Women's PFA Young Player of the Year award for a second season running.

Elsewhere, Declan Rice, William Saliba, Gabriel, Jurrien Timber and David Raya were included in the PFA Team of the Year, with Alessia Russo, Mariona Caldentey and Emily Fox featuring in the PFA WSL Team of the Year.

recentItems.title: WONDER GOALS GALORE 💥 | HIGHLIGHTS | Arsenal Women vs Charlton Athletic (5-1) | Pre-season
recentItems.description:
We put on a show at Meadow Park on Wednesday night, thrashing Charlton Athletic 5-1 to round off pre-season on a high. 

After briefly falling behind in the first half, Georgia Stanway's first Arsenal goal and a cooly-taken Mariona Caldentey penalty put us ahead at the break. 

We then asserted our advantage in the second half with stunning strikes from Kyra Cooney-Cross, Olivia Smith and Frida Maanum completing an outstanding catalogue of goals in a comfortable victory.
